title: Doppler Service token (dp.st.): one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one body byte replaced by -, outside [A-Za-z0-9], alphabet: one body byte replaced by _, outside [A-Za-z0-9], and segment: one uppercase byte outside [a-z0-9_-]. Twin of "Doppler Service token (dp.st.): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of doppler-token-json-api-key: alphabet: one body byte replaced by -, outside [A-Za-z0-9]. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
